sources.title: Mudcracks — SERC/Carleton teaching sedimentary geology, 2008
sources.supports: Fine wet sediment dries into polygons; cracks are wide at top and narrow downward, and mudchip edges may curl upward. Geometry is original; no photographs, site dimensions or age inferred.
